SELECT 
  cls, 
  fish_date_doy, 
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  ROUND(AVG(yt / NULLIF(anglers, 0)), 3) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(MAX(yt / NULLIF(anglers, 0)), 3) as max_yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(SUM(yt), 0) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 280 AND fish_date_doy <= 310
  AND fish_date_season = 2
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy, 
  cls, 
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  ROUND(AVG(yt / NULLIF(anglers, 0)), 3) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(SUM(yt), 0) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 280 AND fish_date_doy <= 310
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;
